answer: Identity here is bought, not claimed: every agent posts a stake that scales with the value it routes, locked for a long cooldown. Launching a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand stakes, so attack cost grows linearly while payoff does not. Cheap accounts cannot create a ripple of influence, since each new identity starts at the edge of the trust meadow, unvouched, and gains weight only as independent peers attest it. One shared crystal of verified reputation cannot be cloned, so duplicate identities stay hollow and their votes weightless.
